title: Logo sources
lede: Logos in AI Zen are each company's latest official logo, left unchanged.
rules: Source: the company's press kit, official website or Wikimedia Commons. Each file names where it came from.
No redrawing, no distorting: colour logos keep their own colours; single-colour marks are tinted in the brand colour. Motion happens only around the logo.
No official file? The company name appears on the stone — we never invent an icon.
